title: ShoeIntent
description: Structured shoe-design intent. Every field is something the pipeline really realises, except 'notes' (recorded only, never used by the pipeline) and 'unsupported_requests' (things the user asked for that the design space cannot do; they are reported, not realised). Numbers must be copied verbatim from the request, even if they look out of range: the system adjusts them afterwards and reports every change. Final intents are validated against strict_schema(), where x-clamp becomes minimum/maximum.

template.description: Which of the two usable designs to rebuild. Sizes are the same design scaled.

pattern.description: PatternSpec (#13). null = the user did not ask for a pattern: the first style tag's preset applies, else kind none.

style_tags.description: Style words mapped to pattern presets (config/intent.toml [style.*]).

instep_ease_mm.description: Instep ease (config/ease_zones.toml). null = keep the configured default.

notes.description: Free text for humans. RECORDED ONLY: it never influences the pipeline.

unsupported_requests.description: Requests the design space cannot realise (heel height, toe shape, colour ...), in the user's own words. They never change other fields.

open_ratio.description: Perforation kinds, and image with image_use perforation.

depth_mm.description: Displacement kinds, and image with image_use displacement.

image.description: Only the pattern image the user supplied; the parser fills it in, a model must leave it null.
